limitations: No device playback, subjective listening qualification or production callback/resource-budget qualification.
Frozen synchronous snapshots rebuild the scene; no asynchronous worker publication, persistent event/voice cursors, streaming or source virtualization.
Direct paths/HRTF only. Absorption/scattering authored but no reflection/reverb or diffraction simulation yet.
Mono 48 kHz PCM16/float32 imports only; no automatic resampling or compressed assets.
C# use moves a native occluder; a C# sound event API is not yet implemented.
One Windows/Linux laptop environment; consoles and broader hardware/platform support unqualified.
DSP differs by floating-point roundoff across OS libraries; different elevation filters do not establish human localization accuracy.
The dynamic-door subset does not complete the full M0 acoustic proof, M2 room or engine roadmap.
public_record_note: Local path strings and private reference labels generalized for publication. Measured results and source/binary digests are unchanged; the original record is retained in a private local archive.
